payload.core_mechanism_summary: Binary search on number of operations, with greedy check that scans array to maintain smallest possible non-decreasing sequence using at most k increments.
payload.rationale: The solution binary searches the minimum operations k and uses a greedy left-to-right pass to verify if the array can be made non-decreasing with ≤k increments per element. No sorting is used in the main logic, so the greedy subtype is the closest fit.
